findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns the raw config, discarding the schedule_type display conversion
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds a copy of the monitor config and rewrites `schedule_type` to its human-readable display value (`config["schedule_type"] = monitor_environment.monitor.get_schedule_type_display()`), but the returned dict sets `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` — the original object, not the modified copy. The local `config` variable is therefore dead code and the occurrence's monitor context always carries the raw integer `schedule_type` instead of e.g. "crontab"/"interval". Since this code is being lifted into a new module as part of a refactor, it is a good moment to fix it: return `config` instead of `monitor_environment.monitor.config`.

findings.title: get_failure_reason docstring shows an output string the function can never produce
findings.body: The docstring lists `"A failed check-in was detected"` as example output, but `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` only contains "An error check-in was detected", "A missed check-in was detected" and "A timeout check-in was detected"; there is no generic "failed" variant. The second example ("... were detected") also doesn't match the template `"%(problem_checkins)s check-ins detected"`. Also note the typos "humam readible". Misleading docs here make it harder to reason about the user-visible failure reason text.

findings.title: Public helpers removed from mark_failed without re-export; external importers will break
findings.body: `mark_failed.py` no longer defines `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` or `SimpleCheckIn`, and they are not re-exported from the module. Any other module, task, or test that does `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import <one of these>` (or patches e.g. `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` in a test) will now fail with ImportError/AttributeError. The PR touches only these four files, so no callers/tests were updated — the whole tree should be grepped for the old names (including mock patch targets, which are string-based and won't be caught by static checks) before merging.
